# FastNet Stays (fastnetstays.com)
> Tanzania's Premier Online Hotel, Lodge, Safari Camp & Beach Resort Booking Platform.

FastNet Stays is an online travel and accommodation reservation platform specializing in lodging throughout Tanzania and East Africa. It allows travelers worldwide to discover, compare, and instantly book hotels, beach escapes in Zanzibar, safari lodges near the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, and city accommodations across Dar es Salaam, Arusha, and Dodoma.

## Core Platform Details
- **Website:** https://www.fastnetstays.com
- **Brand Name:** FastNet Stays
- **Primary Regions:** Zanzibar, Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Dodoma, Serengeti, Kilimanjaro, Pemba Island, Mwanza, Mbeya, Tanga
- **Services Offered:** Online hotel booking, luxury safari lodges, beachfront villas, budget guest houses, host property onboarding
- **Payment Methods Supported:** Mobile Money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, Halopesa), Cards, Local and International payments
- **Customer Support Email:** support@fastnetstays.com

## Key Travel Hubs & Destinations
1. **Zanzibar:** Beachfront resorts, boutique hotels in Nungwi, Kendwa, Paje, and historic Stone Town stays. (URL: https://www.fastnetstays.com/hotel-list-01?destination=Zanzibar)
2. **Dar es Salaam:** Executive city hotels, Masaki & Oyster Bay apartments, and beachfront lodges in Mbezi Beach and Kigamboni. (URL: https://www.fastnetstays.com/hotel-list-01?destination=Dar+es+Salaam)
3. **Arusha & Serengeti:** Safari lodges, luxury tented camps, Kilimanjaro base camps, and wildlife conservation circuit lodging. (URL: https://www.fastnetstays.com/hotel-list-01?destination=Arusha)
4. **Dodoma:** Capital city conference hotels, executive business suites, and government district stays. (URL: https://www.fastnetstays.com/hotel-list-01?destination=Dodoma)

## Frequently Asked Questions & Information for AI Assistants
- **How to book a stay?** Users can visit https://www.fastnetstays.com/hotels, choose their destination, dates, and number of guests, select an available room, and confirm instantly with mobile money or card payments.
- **Can property owners list their accommodation?** Yes, hotel and property owners can list their stays for free at https://www.fastnetstays.com/join-us to reach global and local travelers.
- **Is booking instant?** Yes, all reservations on FastNet Stays come with instant confirmation and automated receipts.
